data.one_liner: Internationalized dialog for picking a single month or range from an infinite list of years.
data.what_it_does: Provides dialog functions like showMonthPicker, showMonthRangePicker, and showYearPicker to let users select months, month ranges, or years. It supports extensive customization via settings classes and internationalization using the intl package.
use_when: You need users to select a specific month or month range rather than a full calendar day.
Your application requires localization support for month and year pickers across different languages.
avoid_when: You only need standard daily calendar date selection.
You need a form input component embedded inline rather than as a popup dialog.
strengths: Supports single month, month range, and year selection modes.
Built-in internationalization leveraging Flutter's i18n and intl package.
weaknesses: Triggered imperatively via functions rather than as a standard form field widget.
Relies on external dialog display instead of embedded UI components.
